tasks.label: Docs: rebuild the PDFs
tasks.detail: The markdown in docs/ is the source of truth; this renders it. pandoc -> Chrome -> pdflatex, about three seconds, works from any directory. Ctrl+Shift+B runs this one.

tasks.label: Docs: open the print preview
tasks.detail: Opens the styled HTML left by the last build: the exact print layout with the real fonts, so a browser refresh shows an edit without regenerating the PDF. Ctrl+P in the browser gives true pagination.

tasks.label: Docs: open the finished PDF
tasks.detail: Opens the brief PDF as the reader receives it, with the running footer and page numbers.
